deportes-orchestrator.description: Primary orchestrator for deportes-web. Routes work across skills (triage, to-prd, to-issues, tdd, diagnose, zoom-out, improve-codebase-architecture) and operational subagents (explorer, architect, implementer, tester, reviewer, docs-writer).

explorer.description: Read-only codebase explorer. Use for /zoom-out, audits, and gather-before-delegate phases.

architect.description: Designs modules, interfaces, and ADRs. Use for /improve-codebase-architecture proposals, /grill-me plans, and seam decisions before implementation.

implementer.description: Writes code in a worktree once the architect has a plan. Trivial edits (typos, one-liners) are done inline by the orchestrator; this agent handles non-trivial implementation in parallel with the reviewer/tester loop.

tester.description: Writes and runs tests with TDD. Use for red-green-refactor loops, regression tests, and verifying fixes per /tdd.

reviewer.description: Reviews code changes, PRs, and architecture decisions for correctness, regressions, and adherence to CONTEXT.md/ADRs.

docs-writer.description: Maintains CONTEXT.md, ADRs in docs/adr/, and any durable design notes. Updates docs after every architectural or domain-language decision.
